# Discover Islam

> Discover Islam through clear, honest guides: the Qur'an, Allah, Prophet Muhammad, prayer, Jesus in Islam, history — answers to common questions. Written from a Muslim voice for curious non-Muslims worldwide.

Discover Islam (https://bofrahi12.github.io/islamic-civilization-explorer/) is a free educational website that explains Islam to curious non-Muslims — especially readers in the USA and Europe. All content is in English and written from a warm Muslim-insider voice ("we believe", "our Qur'an", "our Prophet"). The site follows a strict source discipline: the Qur'an, graded hadith (with collection and grade named), history, and interpretation are always distinguished, and real scholarly disagreements are named rather than hidden.

## Start here

- [Start Here](https://bofrahi12.github.io/islamic-civilization-explorer/start-here): the guided path for a first-time visitor
- [What Is Islam?](https://bofrahi12.github.io/islamic-civilization-explorer/what-is-islam): a simple introduction for beginners
- [Explore](https://bofrahi12.github.io/islamic-civilization-explorer/explore): the discovery hub
- [All Articles](https://bofrahi12.github.io/islamic-civilization-explorer/articles): the full guide index (97 guides)
- [Glossary](https://bofrahi12.github.io/islamic-civilization-explorer/glossary): key Islamic terms explained

## For someone considering Islam

- [Thinking of Becoming Muslim](https://bofrahi12.github.io/islamic-civilization-explorer/articles/thinking-of-becoming-muslim): honest answers to real fears, no pressure
- [The Shahada](https://bofrahi12.github.io/islamic-civilization-explorer/shahada): the testimony of faith, in English and Arabic
